fields.summary: Autonomous plan run of the Parity harness change set (milestone 39, 2026-11-15). No owner interview: the orchestrator, as arbiter, said design choices are the planner's, to be recorded as assumed Decisions with a reasoning field, and that the owner's 'Ok' (milestone chat, question 2) makes the strict engine in internal/model the spec. The change set already held three leaves from the milestone plan. The research pass found what they left open: the two api models and the strict engine define a node's version differently. The interim model (internal/api/model.go) and write_indexed.go's versionOf take the largest head of the base graph and set Conflict when there are two heads; the strict engine's version is the last operation applied, and a conflict is a Problem only when a stale operation overlaps an aspect (disjoint edits merge silently). Writes refuse a node or link with Conflict set (write_node.go writableNode and buildRetire, write_link.go), and set.txtar and write_test.go LandedConflict pin that for two heads writing the same field, which the strict rule also reports. Pending has no strict counterpart. The index already computes the strict what-if (index.WhatIfOverlay over model.WhatIfDelta), while writeIndex.buildModel re-applies in-flight ops by the interim rules. The interim model is deleted by the milestone's projection change set. newModelSets is also called per candidate in daemon_fold.go, proposals.go and inbox.go. The planner settled the version and conflict rule the harness compares, how disagreements are fixed (derive from the strict engine instead of re-implementing it), that the harness lands green with a named known-cases table, and that the generator of internal/index/property_test.go moves to a test-only package. It refined the three leaves to say so.
fields.title: Parity harness plan, autonomous
